exact_statement:
theorem robust_permanent :
  ∃ p₀ : ℝ, 4 / 3 < p₀ ∧ p₀ < 2 ∧
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ ν : Law,
      IsProbability ν → totalVariation ν < ε → UniformMarginals ν →
      ∀ f : Functions, (∀ i j, 0 ≤ f i j) →
        permanentExpectation ν f ≤ ∏ i, lpNorm p₀ (f i)
